final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT o.ordertune AS ordertune, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY o.ordertune), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.ordertune, s1.cnt, CAST(s1.cnt AS REAL) / s2.total AS ratio FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.total IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.ordertune, s3.cnt, s3.ratio, s3.ratio - s4.avg_ratio AS diff FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.ratio > s4.avg_ratio) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(diff) AS avg_diff FROM s5
